instruction: Get all videos at /api/videos. How many published videos are there?
Search videos at /api/search?q=cooking. How many results?
Get video 1 at /api/videos/1. What is the video title?
Get categories at /api/categories. How many categories exist?
Filter videos by category at /api/videos?category=Education. How many?
Get stats at /api/stats. How many total views across all videos?
Filter by duration at /api/videos?duration_min=300&duration_max=900. How many?
Filter by date at /api/videos?date_from=2025-01-01. How many?
Sort videos by views at /api/videos?sort=views. What is the first video title?
Semantic search at /api/search/semantic?q=outdoor adventure nature. How many results?
POST /api/videos/1/playback with speed=1.5, quality=720p. Does it return the config?
POST /api/videos/1/share with platform=twitter. Does it return share URL?
POST /api/videos/1/comments with text='Great video!', user_id=1. Does it create a comment?
POST /api/videos/1/like with action=like. Does it increment likes?
POST /api/videos/1/rate with rating=5, user_id=1. Does it rate?
POST /api/videos/1/save with user_id=1. Does it toggle save?
POST /api/channels/1/subscribe with user_id=2. Does it toggle subscription?
POST /api/channels/1/follow with user_id=2. Does it toggle follow?
POST /api/videos/1/report with reason=spam. Does it create a report?
POST /api/videos with title='Test Video', channel_id=1, category=Education. Does it create?
